capabilities.scope: Vendor firmware/device-tree microSD boot and eight cores; SDR104 at 150 MHz.
Gigabit full-duplex YT8531 with measured RGMII delays. The combined CPU6 graphics profile sustained TCP above 933 Mbit/s. One short UDP receive trial lost 180 datagrams at the socket-buffer boundary.
WPA2/CCMP on both bands with 802.11n; requires vendor firmware.
USB-C high-speed storage tested in one orientation. A Logitech 046d:c534 USB-C receiver provided pointer input. SuperSpeed and USB-A peripherals remain unqualified.
Graphics DTB: PowerVR BVNC 36.56.104.183 at 600 MHz, Vulkan offscreen readback, and accelerated Plasma on virtual and physical HDMI outputs.

Stock Plasma ran on physical HDMI at 1280 × 1024 and 60.020 Hz. On EmberBSD 073d12427, a separate CPU-filled KMS workload completed 2000 flips in 33.408 seconds without skipped sequence steps. Cold boot, hotplug, and extended display operation remain unqualified.

Explicit NPU observation mode and privileged fixed INT8 tile ioctl. At 300 MHz, a 24-frame 96 × 96 contour clip and one 720 × 540 frame run from cold and warm contexts matched the CPU reference. The graphics profile also verified direct tile submission and repeated 96 × 96 contour processing during accelerated virtual Plasma.
